title: platform-admin re-anchor (L5 removal half): delete the legacy grant-row read — one minor after L4's landing
body:
The **removal half of L5** of the accepted #11663 platform-admin re-anchor design, filed at L4's landing exactly as #11975 and the design prescribe (design document = #11663 comment 5394453215, §5 step 6 and §6 row L5: "the dual read is deleted, one minor after step 4. Card filed at step 4's landing, not later"; maintainer acceptance = #11663 comment 5404675670, 2026-08-25, verbatim 「接受你的建议，继续」). Filed by the L4 dev at PR #13514's creation, per the L4 card's own definition of done. #11975 remains open and carries the window's discipline; this card is the window's EXIT.

Restart-when: `@objectstack/plugin-security` has published a minor **greater than** the one carrying L4 (PR #13514 / `.changeset/walled-bootstrap-stops-granting.md`). Measured 2026-08-31: L4 is **not** in 17.2.0 and 0 major changesets are pending ⇒ L4 ships in 17.3.0, so this exit lands **no earlier than 17.4.0**.
Restart-touch: `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`

⛔ **NOT `Blocked-by: #11975`** — that line was removed 2026-09-01 because it formed a **mutual deadlock**. #11975 carries `Blocked-by: #13515`, so the two cards named each other and neither unlock predicate ("the Blocked-by target is closed") could ever fire. #11975 → #13515 is the **sound** edge and stays: its acceptance criterion genuinely needs this exit on `main`. This edge was the false one — what this card actually waits for is a **release boundary**, which was wrongly encoded as a card dependency and is now written as the boundary it is. Diagnosed by triage on this card 2026-08-31; repaired by the `domain:services` PM seat, to whom triage routed it.

**Timing constraint (the minor boundary):** lands **one minor after** the release that carries L4 (PR #13514, `@objectstack/plugin-security` walled bootstrap stops minting the grant row + deprecation pointer live). The exit PR's body must name the minor boundary it honours (#11975's acceptance criterion).

**Content — delete the legacy path, as its own reviewed change (never a rider on another leg):**

- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` §6b: the legacy arm that flips `hasPlatformAdminGrant` from an unscoped, in-window `admin_full_access` USER grant row stops conferring `PLATFORM_ADMIN` — after this card, only the §6b-config anchor confers it (walled AND single postures per whatever state #11979 / Choice 4B is in at that time; if 4B has not landed, the `single` posture's row-derived standing must be carved out explicitly, not deleted with the window).
- `reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant` and its boot-side detection in `plugin-security/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` retire with the read they warn about (the pointer's job is done when the row confers nothing).
- Re-derive the readers at that time: `last-admin-guard` (re-priced by L3 #11973), explain provenance, the standing surface — none may silently change answer for `single`-posture rigs.

**Acceptance criterion:** on a walled rig, a seeded legacy org-less `admin_full_access` grant confers NOTHING (posture resolves without `PLATFORM_ADMIN` unless the config anchor matches); the exit is a reviewed change on `origin/main` whose PR body names the minor boundary; `single`-posture first-user standing is unchanged unless #11979 landed first.
